item.title: Event Horizon
item.description:
Event Horizon is a Cryptotheology upgrade under the Religion tab that fundamentally expands your late-game resource limits.

Unlike standard bonfire or space buildings, Cryptotheology structures are bought using Relics and persist permanently across resets.

Cost & Requirements

  • Tab: Religion to Cryptotheology
  • Unlock Requirement: Requires building a Black Pyramid (via Ziggurat sacrifices) to access the Cryptotheology panel.
  • Cost: Scales exponentially in Relics and Void:
    • Relic Cost: approx 100 times 1.25^N
    • Void Cost: Scales alongside relics per purchase rank.

What It Does

Event Horizon is a Cryptotheology upgrade under the Religion tab that fundamentally expands your late-game resource limits.

Unlike standard bonfire or space buildings, Cryptotheology structures are bought using Relics and persist permanently across resets.

Cost & Requirements

  • Tab: Religion to Cryptotheology
  • Unlock Requirement: Requires building a Black Pyramid (via Ziggurat sacrifices) to access the Cryptotheology panel.
  • Cost: Scales exponentially in Relics and Void:
    • Relic Cost: approx 100 times 1.25^N
    • Void Cost: Scales alongside relics per purchase rank.

What It Does

  • Compounding Global Storage Bonus: Each purchase of Event Horizon increases maximum storage capacity across all standard resources (Catnip, Wood, Minerals, Iron, Coal, Titanium, Oil, Unobtainium, Uranium, etc.).

  • The Math:

    Storage Multiplier = (1 + 0.10)^N = 1.10^N

    Every level grants a +10% compounding bonus to overall storage caps.

  • Stacking with Void Rifts: While Void Rifts (in the Space tab) also give compounding storage bonuses, Void Rifts reset when you reset your game. Event Horizon provides a permanent baseline that makes every subsequent run start with larger storage caps out of the gate.

Why It Is Critical in Late Game

  1. Unlocking Late-Game Price Thresholds: Late-game science techs, high-tier Chronospheres, AI Cores, and deep space missions have astronomical resource costs that standard Barns, Warehouses, and Harbors cannot hold. Event Horizon pushes those ceilings higher.
  2. Fueling the Shatter Loop: Higher Unobtainium caps mean you can hold more Unobtainium per time-shattered year via Resource Retrieval, allowing for larger bulk trades with Leviathans without overflowing and wasting materials.
  3. Reset Cushion: Because Event Horizon never resets, future runs reach high-capacity storage rapidly, letting you build advanced housing and factories much earlier.

Spending Recommendation

With a solid Relic reserve (such as 100k–200k+ Relics), aim for 15–25 levels of Event Horizon. Balancing Event Horizon with Black Nexus (which boosts Relic/TC yields from Leviathan trades) ensures your resource caps grow alongside your trade volume.

item.title: Singularity
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Singularity is a high-level Metaphysics upgrade that serves as a massive force multiplier for your late-game resource production. It represents the point where your civilization’s technological and spiritual progress merge into a single, unstoppable advancement.

Key Effects

The Singularity is unique because it provides a global production bonus that scales with your total number of Metaphysics upgrades:

  • Global Production Bonus: It provides a +5% bonus to all production.
  • The “Price Ratio” Capstone: While upgrades like Golden Ratio and Vitruvian Feline reduce the price of buildings, Singularity is often the final “big purchase” players make in the Metaphysics tree before focusing entirely on Paragon hoarding or Cryptotheology.
  • Multiplier Synergy: This 5% is multiplicative. In your current stage—dealing with Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion—this small percentage translates to massive raw gains in Unobtainium, Antimatter, and Void.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Singularity in your Metaphysics tab, you must have progressed through the “feline” hierarchy of upgrades (Malkuth, Yesod, etc.):

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Metaphysics Tab Requires Astronomy, Philosophy, and a Ziggurat.
Zodiac Prerequisite You must have purchased the Zodiac upgrade first.
Paragon Resource 250 Paragon

Strategic Context

Given that you are managing complex late-game systems, the Singularity is essentially your “end-game” badge for a standard run.

  1. Paragon Management: 250 Paragon is a significant investment. You should only buy Singularity if you already have the core Price Ratio upgrades (Engineering, Golden Ratio, Vitruvian Feline, Renaissance). If you don’t have those, the price reduction they offer is mathematically superior to the 5% production boost from Singularity.
  2. The Dark Future: If you are pushing toward Year 40,000+ (the Dark Future), every percentage point matters. Singularity helps counteract the production penalties that can occur when Temporal Distortion gets out of hand.
  3. Reset Planning: Since Metaphysics upgrades are permanent, buying Singularity makes every subsequent run 5% faster from the very first minute. It makes the “early game slog” almost non-existent.

Expert Tip: If you are currently farming Void, the 5% bonus from Singularity also applies to the effectiveness of your Void Resonators, slightly increasing the frequency of your paradoxes and your total Void yield.

Summary: Should you buy it now?

  • YES: If you have over 750 total Paragon and already own Renaissance.
  • NO: If you are still struggling to lower building prices. Save that Paragon for Renaissance (750 Paragon) first; it is the single most powerful upgrade in the game.

item.content:encoded:
Transcendence is a late-game religious mechanic that allows you to spend Epiphany (also known as the Apocrypha bonus) to permanently increase your Transcendence Tier. These tiers carry over through resets and provide powerful scaling for your faith production, religious upgrades, and endgame buildings.

Unlocking Transcendence

To access this system, you must first research Theology and then purchase the Transcendence upgrade in the Religion tab.

  • Cost: 7,500 Faith and 7,500 Gold.
  • Requirement: A maximum Faith capacity of at least 125,000.
  • Function: Unlocking this provides the Transcend button, which is used to level up your tier by sacrificing a portion of your accumulated Epiphany.

Core Benefits and Effects

Transcending is essential for transitioning into the mid-to-late game “Relic Era” due to the following effects:

  • Adoration Multiplier: Each tier significantly increases the conversion multiplier when you Adore the Galaxy, allowing you to rebuild your Praise bonus much faster after a reset.
  • Multi-level Upgrades: It allows you to purchase several religious upgrades (such as Scholasticism, Golden Spire, and Sun Altar) multiple times, though each additional level costs 2.5x more than the last.
  • Cryptotheology Gateway: Advanced endgame structures are gated by specific Transcendence Tiers. For example, Black Obelisks require Tier 1, while the powerful Blazars require Tier 15.
  • Atheism Challenge Synergy: If you complete the Atheism challenge, your Solar Revolution cap increases by 100 percentage points for every Transcendence Tier you have attained.

Strategic Advice: The “TAP” Method

Experienced players use a specific sequence called TAP to manage their faith bonuses effectively without destroying their current production.

  1. Transcend: Level up your tier when you have roughly 1.5x the required Epiphany for that level to avoid losing too much of your bonus.
  2. Adore: Immediately “Adore the Galaxy” to convert your remaining Worship into a now-stronger Epiphany bonus.
  3. Praise: Praise the sun with a full store of faith to quickly regain your Solar Revolution production boost.

Transcendence Tier Requirements

The cost in Epiphany scales exponentially with each tier:

Tier Minimum Epiphany Needed Key Unlock / Benefit
1 ~1.97% Black Obelisk
3 ~17.38% Black Nexus
9 ~151.34K% Black Library
15 ~3.04M% Blazar (Vital for Relic production)
20 ~451.14M% Dark Nova
25 ~66.96G% Holy Genocide (Post Apocalypse challenge)

Because the Epiphany requirement for Tier 15 is over 3 million percent, it is considered a major long-term goal for the late-game Relic and Time Crystal engine.

Transcendence Tiers carry over permanently through resets,. They are part of a select group of endgame achievements and prestige markers that are not lost when you restart your timeline.

Carry-over Mechanics

  • Permanent Progression: Once you reach a certain Transcendence Tier, it remains active in all subsequent runs,.
  • Cryptotheology Visibility: While the tiers themselves are saved, you must re-research the Cryptotheology technology in each new run to view your tier level or purchase/interact with the associated buildings.
  • Epiphany and Adoration: Your tiers increase the conversion multiplier when you “Adore the Galaxy”, making your future faith resets more powerful.

Key Benefits of Retaining Tiers

Maintaining your tiers across resets provides several compounding advantages:

  • Religious Scaling: Tiers allow you to purchase certain religious upgrades multiple times (like Solar Chant or Golden Spire) at an escalating cost.
  • Solar Revolution Cap: If you have completed the Atheism challenge, your Solar Revolution production bonus cap is increased by 100% for every Transcendence Tier you have attained,.
  • Cryptotheology Unlocks: Higher tiers are required to unlock advanced permanent buildings, such as Black Obelisks (Tier 1) or Blazars (Tier 15),.

A Black Core is a late-game Cryptotheology building that increases your maximum limit of Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) by +1%. This expansion of the sorrow cap is essential for scaling your religious infrastructure as you approach the endgame.

Costs and Requirements

  • Initial Cost: 10,000 Relics.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: You must reach Transcendence Tier 5 to unlock it.

Strategic Utility

The Black Core is a fundamental piece of the “Relic Engine” because it allows for the continued construction of Black Pyramids:

  • Bypassing the Sorrow Cap: The base storage cap for Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) is 16. Since each Black Pyramid requires 5 units of sorrow to build, you are naturally restricted in how many pyramids you can own.
  • Scaling Pyramids: By building Black Cores, you increase the BLS limit, allowing you to accumulate the sorrow necessary to purchase more pyramids.
  • Synergy with Relic Production: Increasing your pyramid count is critical for the Black Nexus. The Black Nexus improves relic production from space beacons and Time Crystal refinement by a factor determined by your total number of Black Pyramids.

Operational Context

The Black Core belongs to Phase 3 (Late/Endgame) of development. It is a permanent investment that carries over through resets, provided you research the “Cryptotheology” technology in each new run to view the buildings you have purchased.

At this stage, players typically focus on “chasing infinity” by using these cores to maximise the efficiency of their Time Crystal and Relic engines.

item.title: Black Library
item.description:
The Black Library is an advanced Cryptotheology building used to scale your science storage cap by enhancing the effectiveness of your existing religious and scientific upgrades. It is a permanent structure that carries over through resets, allowing for exponential growth in science capacity across multiple runs.

Requirements and Costs

Because it is part of the endgame “Phase 3” progression, the requirements for the Black Library are steep:

  • Cost: 30,000 Relics.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: You must have attained Transcendence Tier 9.
  • Technology: You must research the Cryptotheology technology each run to view or purchase these buildings.

Primary Effect: Codex Scaling

The Black Library focuses on improving the Codex Leviathanianus, a metaphysics upgrade that increases your compendia science limit based on your Transcendence tier.

A Black Nexus is a high-tier Cryptotheology building found in the Religion tab that serves as a cornerstone for scaling your late-game relic production. It is designed to make the conversion of Time Crystals into Relics more efficient and to boost the passive generation of relics from space-based structures.

Core Mechanics and Costs

  • Cost: 5,000 Relics.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: You must have attained Transcendence Tier 3 to unlock it.
  • Synergy: Its effectiveness is directly tied to the number of Black Pyramids you have constructed.

Primary Effects

The Black Nexus enhances two specific methods of obtaining relics:

  1. Time Crystal Refinement: Standard refinement converts 25 Time Crystals into 1 Relic. With a Black Nexus, the yield increases according to the formula: 1 + (Black Nexus × Black Pyramid) relics per 25 crystals.
  2. Relic Station Production: It significantly boosts the output of Relic Stations (upgraded Space Beacons). Each Black Nexus improves this production by 10% per Black Pyramid.

Strategic Utility: The “Type 1 Relic Engine”

In the mid-to-late game, the Black Nexus is a vital part of what players call the “Type 1 Relic Engine”.

  • Scaling Passive Income: Once you have at least 5,000 maximum Antimatter, Relic Stations produce 0.01 relics per day. By stacking Black Nexuses and Black Pyramids, you can increase this passive daily income to a point where you no longer rely solely on manual trading with Leviathans for your relic supply.
  • Synergy with Black Sky: Completing the Black Sky challenge provides an “invisible” Black Pyramid, which permanently improves the scaling of your Black Nexus buildings in all future runs.
  • Late-Game Goal: Experienced players recommend buying several levels of Black Nexus alongside Black Core (to increase the sorrow limit for more pyramids) to maximise the efficiency of your time-skipping and relic-farming operations.

Comparison Table: Relic Scaling

Feature Standard Effect With Black Nexus
TC to Relic Ratio 25:1 25 : (1 + Nexus × Pyramid)
Beacon Production 0.01 Relics/day +10% boost per Pyramid level
Unlock Level Theology Tech Transcendence Tier 3

The Solar Revolution Cap

The standard Solar Revolution bonus is typically capped at 1000%, with diminishing returns beginning at 750%. Black Obelisks are the primary method for raising this ceiling:

  • Scaling Formula: Every obelisk improves the cap by +5% per Transcendence Tier.
  • Multiplicative Synergies: This effect is multiplicative with the rewards gained from completing the Atheism Challenge.

Strategic Context

In the late game (Phase 3), the Black Obelisk is often compared to the Atheism Challenge reward. Completing the Atheism Challenge provides a base reward that increases the Solar Revolution cap by 100 percentage points per Transcendence Tier, which the sources note is the equivalent of owning 20 Black Obelisks.

For players focusing on a “Relic Engine” run, stacking these obelisks alongside high Transcendence Tiers is essential for maximizing global production modifiers.

What It Does

  • Raises the Solar Revolution Diminishing Returns Limit:

    • Base Solar Revolution provides a massive global percentage boost to all production, but it normally begins hitting diminishing returns around a theoretical maximum (base cap around $1,000%$).
    • Each Black Obelisk increases the soft/hard cap ceiling of your Solar Revolution bonus by $+5%$.
    • The formula scales additively per rank:

    {Solar Revolution Cap Multiplier} = 1 + (0.05 times Black Obelisks)

  • Synergy with Void Resonators & Time Shattering:

    • When shattering Time Crystals, Void Resonators project your Solar Revolution bonus across skipped years.
    • Without Black Obelisks, your massive accumulated faith hits a hard plateau. Black Obelisks allow that bonus to keep climbing into thousands of percent of global production.

Strategic Priority

Upgrade Primary Focus Synergy with Black Obelisk
Black Nexus Boosts Relic/TC trade yields Fuels the Relics needed to buy Obelisks
Event Horizon Multiplies storage caps Lets you store more Unobtainium per shatter
Black Obelisk Scales faith production ceiling Multiplies the output of all ground resources

A Blazar is a high-tier Cryptotheology building that serves as a cornerstone for the late-game “time crystal engine”. It is a permanent structure that carries over through resets, though you must research the Cryptotheology technology in each new run to access its benefits.

Requirements and Cost

Because it is a pinnacle endgame structure, the barriers to entry are significant:

  • Cost: 50,000 Relics.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: Transcendence Tier 15. Reaching this tier requires a massive accumulation of Epiphany (roughly 3.04 million percent).

Core Effects and Multipliers

Each level of Blazar provides stacking bonuses to several critical late-game mechanics:

  • Resource Retrieval: Improves effectiveness by 2%. This is vital for “shatter engines,” as it increases the resources gained when you skip years using Time Crystals.
  • Time Manipulation: Improves Chronomancy by 2.5%.
  • Unicorn Generation: Improves Unicornmancy by 2.5%.
  • Dark Future Mitigation: Improves Time Impedance by 10%. This helps suppress the temporal penalties encountered once your calendar year exceeds 40,000.

Strategic Utility

The Blazar is primarily used to transition into the “Type 2 Relic Engine” and beyond.

  • Shatter Engine Efficiency: By boosting Resource Retrieval, Blazars allow you to reach a “break-even” point where shattering a Time Crystal provides enough Unobtainium or Alicorns to immediately regain that crystal through trading or sacrifice.
  • Relic Scaling: In the late game, relics are often generated by refining Time Crystals. Blazars, along with Black Nexuses, make this process far more productive, eventually allowing for the “positive resets” necessary to reach the theoretical limits of the game.
  • Infinite Loop Resets: For players aiming to achieve “Infinity”, Blazars are used to grow the Unobtainium stockpile exponentially across short runs, enabling the construction of up to 100 Chronospheres for massive resource carry-over.

While reaching Transcendence Tier 15 is a daunting task, the Blazar is the primary tool used to overcome the late-game bottlenecks of Time Crystals and Relics.

item.title: Dark Nova

Like all Cryptotheology structures, it carries over through resets, although you must re-research the “Cryptotheology” technology in each new run to view or purchase additional units.

Costs and Requirements

Building a Dark Nova represents a significant investment in late-game resources and spiritual progression.

  • Relic Cost: 75,000 Relics.
  • Void Cost: 7,500 Void.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.

item.content:encoded:
Dark Nova is a permanent endgame Cryptotheology building that increases your civilisation’s global energy production by +2% per level. Like all Cryptotheology structures, it carries over through resets, although you must re-research the “Cryptotheology” technology in each new run to view or purchase additional units.

Costs and Requirements

Building a Dark Nova represents a significant investment in late-game resources and spiritual progression.

  • Relic Cost: 75,000 Relics.
  • Void Cost: 7,500 Void.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: You must have attained Transcendence Tier 20 to unlock this building. Reaching Tier 20 requires an accumulation of approximately 451.14M% Epiphany.

Strategic Utility

Dark Nova is situated in the final phase of the game (Phase 3/Endgame), where energy management becomes a primary bottleneck for scientific and industrial expansion.

  • Endgame Power Demands: As you progress toward the “positive reset” loop, you must power high-consumption buildings like AI Cores (which consume increasing energy per unit), Containment Chambers (50 Watts each), and Entanglement Stations (25 Watts each). The +2% global production bonus helps sustain these power-hungry systems.
  • Scaling for Infinity: Advanced players utilize the energy boost to support massive arrays of Sunlifters and Hydro Plants while attempting to reach the 8.14 billion Unobtainium capacity required for 100 Chronospheres.
  • Synergy with Void Rifts: The global energy production bonus stacks with other modifiers, helping to maintain a positive energy surplus during Time Skips, which is necessary for Antimatter generation and the automated “shatter engine”.

Building Tier Context

In the progression of Cryptotheology, Dark Nova is one of the final buildings unlocked, coming after other critical structures like Blazars (Tier 15) but before Mausoleums (Tier 23) and Holy Genocide (Tier 25). It is a foundational component for players seeking to “chase infinity” by overcapping resources through thousands of years of skipped time.

item.content:encoded:
Holy Genocide is the final building in the Cryptotheology section of the Religion tab. It represents the absolute pinnacle of the endgame, requiring an immense investment of resources and spiritual progression to unlock.

Requirements and Costs

Building a Holy Genocide is significantly more expensive than any other religious structure and is gated by the highest Transcendence Tier in the game.

  • Relic Cost: 100,000 Relics.
  • Void Cost: 25,000 Void.
  • Price Ratio: 1.15.
  • Prerequisite: Transcendence Tier 25 (requiring approximately 66.96G% Epiphany).

Primary Effects

The building alters the fundamental math of your kitten population and production to favor high-efficiency resets.

  • Population Penalty: It reduces your maximum kitten capacity by 1% per level (with diminishing returns starting at 75%).
  • Prestige Boost: It provides a +2% bonus to Karma and Paragon gained per kitten upon resetting.
  • Production Compensation: To offset the lower population, it grants +2% kitten production per housing building.
  • Zebra Synergy: For players in Iron Will mode, the building provides the 2% production boost to Zebras without the accompanying decrease in maximum population.

Unlocking the Post Apocalypse Challenge

The most significant utility of Holy Genocide is that it serves as the unlock requirement for the Post Apocalypse challenge.

  • The Challenge: You enter a timeline with 10M ppm of pollution where kittens arrive 10 times slower and natural pollution dissipation is disabled.
  • The Goal: You must clear all pollution within the broken timeline.
  • The Rewards: Successful completion increases the number of cryochambers that can be operational in future runs and unlocks special policies. Each subsequent completion adds +1 to the cryochamber support cap.

Strategic Context

Holy Genocide is considered a “Phase 3” or Endgame structure. Because the building and your Transcendence Tier carry over through resets, it is used by advanced players to “chase infinity” by overcapping resources and maximizing the efficiency of Paragon farming. By the time you can afford this building, you are likely using a Type 2 Relic Engine or a Shatter Engine to generate the necessary thousands of relics and void units required for construction.
